title: Mario Cipollini Stalking and Abuse Case Ends as Statute of Limitations Expires
content:
An Italian court ended a stalking and abuse case against former world champion Mario Cipollini and vacated his three-year sentence after the statute of limitations expired.

Read the full article at Mario Cipollini Stalking and Abuse Case Ends as Statute of Limitations Expires on Velo.
author: ahood
